info.name: LMS Complete API - Dashboard & Website
info.description: مجموعة Postman كاملة لجميع APIs: الداشبورد، الموقع، الأدمن. استخدم {{base_url}} و {{admin_token}} أو {{token}}

request.description:
تسجيل دخول الأدمن. يرجع token في data.token — يُحفظ تلقائياً في admin_token

cURL:
curl -X POST '{{base_url}}/admin-login' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"your-password"}'

تسجيل دخول المستخدم. يرجع token في data.token — يُحفظ تلقائياً في token

cURL: curl -X POST '{{base_url}}/user-login' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"user@example.com","password":"xxx","type":"email","firebase_token":"FIREBASE_ID_TOKEN"}'

بيانات الداشبورد الكاملة (إحصائيات، رسوم بيانية، أنشطة، إلخ). حالياً بدون auth.

cURL: curl -X GET '{{base_url}}/dashboard-data' -H 'Accept: application/json'
cURL: curl -X GET '{{base_url}}/admin/categories?per_page=15' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Accept: application/json'
cURL: curl -X POST '{{base_url}}/admin/categories' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"New Category","slug":"new-category","status":true}'
cURL: curl -X PUT '{{base_url}}/admin/categories/1' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Updated","slug":"updated"}'
cURL: curl -X POST '{{base_url}}/admin/categories/reorder' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"order":[3,1,2]}'
cURL: curl -X PUT '{{base_url}}/admin/users/1' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"New Name","is_active":true}'

status: pending|completed|cancelled|failed
cURL: curl -X PUT '{{base_url}}/admin/orders/1/status' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"completed"}'

cURL: curl -X POST '{{base_url}}/finance/admin/withdrawal-request/update-status' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"withdrawal_request_id":1,"status":"approved"}'
